title: Callvale after: CloudFront in front of everything
claim: Users reach the nearest edge location, static files come from its cache, recordings need signed URLs, and dynamic requests go to the load balancer.
alt: After: users connect to CloudFront. Static files come from the edge cache or from the private bucket callvale-web through origin access control. Recordings come from the private bucket callvale-audio and need a signed URL. Dynamic requests go to the Application Load Balancer and the web instances.

edges.label: nearest edge
edges.say: Users connect to the edge location with the lowest latency.

edges.label: OAC
edges.say: Static files come from the cache, or from the bucket through origin access control.

edges.label: signed URL
edges.say: A recording needs a signed URL with an ending time.

edges.label: dynamic
edges.say: Dynamic requests go to the load balancer, locked by the prefix list and a secret header.

notes: Brief 15 story pair, after; 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Decision). Same cells as cloudfront-before.
